audit_items.proof_trace: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY has no NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix, so Next.js's build pipeline never includes it in client bundles. The server.ts module imports cookies() from next/headers (a server-only API), creating a structural barrier that prevents client-side import at build time. All consumers (actions.ts, actions-new.ts with 'use server' directive; dashboard/layout.tsx and lib/services/* without 'use client') are server-side; client.ts uses only NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.
